answer: Each epoch a beacon fires on a knoll at a random minute and every agent must send its claim by falcon courier, one claim per flight, each flight taking ten wall-clock minutes, so one operator cannot fly n clones through one window. The claim rides sealed in basalt, a proof stamped with the beacon's fresh random value that cannot be precomputed, and seals sharing one funding trail tally as one share. The aviary fee doubles per extra falcon from one trail, so n clones pay n flights plus 2 to the n in fees yet split one share, while one honest agent pays one flight and keeps the whole catch.
